# rm_gp_ml: ML decision stage registers (generated by regmap_ml.py; do not edit)

Added to the base design's map (docs/register_map.md, whose rules apply: **unmapped addresses** read 0 and ignore writes, **reserved bits** read 0 and are ignored on write, **reads have no side effects**, the status words are read from a **snapshot** taken by CMD bit 2). Present only in build rm_gp_ml: FEATURES (0x008) **bit 8 reads 1** there. The stage lives in the core clock (TXUSRCLK2); the configuration crosses by the same request/acknowledge handshake as the other configuration (hs_vec) and the status words come back the same way, a few clocks old.

| Address | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x300 | ML_CTRL | RW (bit 1 W1P) | 0 | bit 0 VETO: 0 = shadow (the rule decides alone; a decision the model would have stopped is only counted, MLV6); 1 = veto (a rule decision for the tracked instrument sends no order unless the model's class for the message is "up"; a vetoed decision takes no order number and is counted, MLV5). bit 1 RESET_STATE: write 1 to clear the stage's state (book, windows, snapshot, pending message) and its counters; reads 0. Other bits reserved. |
| 0x304 | ML_INST | RW | 1 | bits 15:0 the tracked instrument (reset 1, the generator's instrument). Messages for other instruments are never classified and never move the stage's state; the rule's decisions for them pass unchanged. |
| 0x308 | ML_ID | RO | 0x01130001 | Identifier of the ML registers: 0x0113 (brief 113), version 1. |
| 0x310 to 0x344 | MLV0 to MLV13 | RO | 0 | Status snapshot of the ML stage, 14 words (MLV0 is 0x310), taken by CMD bit 2 together with RXV and TXV. See the table below. |

## MLV words

| Word | Address | Content |
|---|---|---|
| MLV0 | 0x310 | n_obs: frames the rule path accepted whose message is for the tracked instrument (the stage observed it at the price word) |
| MLV1 | 0x314 | n_cls_down: observed messages whose class was 0 (down) |
| MLV2 | 0x318 | n_cls_flat: observed messages whose class was 1 (flat) |
| MLV3 | 0x31C | n_cls_up: observed messages whose class was 2 (up) |
| MLV4 | 0x320 | n_dec: decisions the rule wanted to act on (armed, not killed, TRADE_EN, price test passed) for the tracked instrument |
| MLV5 | 0x324 | n_veto: decisions stopped by the model (veto mode only) |
| MLV6 | 0x328 | n_would_veto: decisions the model would have stopped (shadow mode only) |
| MLV7 | 0x32C | n_late: observations made before the class had settled (must be 0; with frames at least 10 clocks apart it cannot happen) |
| MLV8 | 0x330 | n_apply: good frames whose message moved the state |
| MLV9 | 0x334 | n_drop: bad frames (FCS, length or error character) whose message was observed and then discarded |
| MLV10 | 0x338 | n_race: a state update arrived before the class pipeline had settled from the previous one (must be 0) |
| MLV11 | 0x33C | last_feat[31:0]: the 38-bit feature vector of the last observed message, low word (dir[37:36] ofi[35:28] trades[27:23] imb[22:20] spread[19:16] ask[15:8] bid[7:0]) |
| MLV12 | 0x340 | bits 7:6 the last observed message's class, bits 5:0 last_feat[37:32] |
| MLV13 | 0x344 | debug view: the low bytes of the tracked instrument's book: [31:24] best bid price, [23:16] best bid size, [15:8] best ask price, [7:0] best ask size |

## What a user could guess wrong

- **Shadow is the reset state.** ML_CTRL resets to 0: the rule decides exactly as in build rm_gp and the model only counts. Veto mode must be switched on.
- **Counters clear with CMD bit 0 (the base counters' clear) and with ML_CTRL bit 1.** Only ML_CTRL bit 1 also clears the stage's state (book, order-flow window, trade window, previous snapshot). The state is also cleared whenever the transmit side restarts (any GT reset that drops TX_DONE).
- **Messages move the state only when their frame ends good.** A frame with a bad FCS, a length different from its IPv4 length plus 18, or a cut by an error character is observed (counted in n_obs and by class) but changes nothing (n_drop). A message in a frame longer than 60 bytes of IPv4 length (two or more messages), for another port, another MAC address or with a bad header is not observed at all: the rule path does not act on it either.
- **The class is of the book BEFORE the message.** No input of the model depends on the message's own price, size, type or side; the message moves the state after the decision. So the first message after a reset or a restart is classified on an empty book.
- **The stage sees the first message of a frame only**, like the rule.
- **A decision for another instrument is never vetoed** (it passes as if the stage were not there), whatever the class.
- **A buy needs "up".** The base design only sends buys. Class 2 = up, 1 = flat, 0 = down; ties between class scores go to the lower index (gbt_comb).
- **n_late is a fail-closed counter.** If a decision ever came before the class had settled, in veto mode it is vetoed (counted in n_late and n_veto).
- **Changing ML_INST** changes which messages are tracked from the next message on; the state (a book of the previous instrument) is not cleared, write ML_CTRL bit 1 as well.
- **Latency.** The model adds no clock to the tick-to-trade in either mode (docs/ml_stage.md); this holds only while frames are at least 10 clocks apart.
